1.english_reference: Now after this it came to pass

traditions.KJV: brought gifts .

3.english_reference: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ צוֹבָ֖ה חֲמָ֑תָ ה

traditions.VUL: Eo témpore percússit David étiam Adarézer regem Soba regiónis Hemath ,
traditions.KJV: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath ,

3.english_reference: as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates

traditions.WLC: בְּ לֶכְתּ֕ וֹ לְ הַצִּ֥יב יָד֖ וֹ בִּֽ נְהַר פְּרָֽת
traditions.LXX: πορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἐπιστῆσαι χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ ποταμὸν Εὐφράτην .
traditions.VUL: quando perréxit ut dilatáret impérium suum usque ad flumen Euphráten .
traditions.KJV: as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .

4.english_reference: And David took from him a thousand chariots

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּלְכֹּד֩ דָּוִ֨יד מִמֶּ֜ נּוּ אֶ֣לֶף רֶ֗כֶב

traditions.KJV: and seven thousand horsemen ,

4.english_reference: David also houghed all the chariot [ horses ]

traditions.VUL: subnervavítque omnes equos cúrruum ,
traditions.KJV: David also houghed all the chariot [ horses ] ,

4.english_reference: but reserved of them an hundred chariots

traditions.WLC: וַ יּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖ נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב

traditions.VUL: excéptis centum quadrígis , quas reservávit sibi .
traditions.KJV: but reserved of them an hundred chariots .

5.english_reference: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק לַ עְז֕וֹר לַ הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν Σύρος ἐκ Δαμασκοῦ βοηθῆσαι Ἁδραάζαρ βασιλεῖ Σουβά ,

traditions.KJV: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah ,

5.english_reference: David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֤ךְ דָּוִיד֙ בַּ אֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים וּ שְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν τῷ Σύρῳ εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν .
traditions.VUL: sed et huius percússit David vigínti duo míllia virórum .
traditions.KJV: David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .

6.english_reference: Then David put [ garrisons ] in Syriadamascus

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֤שֶׂם דָּוִיד֙ בַּ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθετο Δαυεὶδ φρουρὰν ἐν Συρίᾳ τῇ κατὰ Δαμασκόν ,
traditions.VUL: Et pósuit mílites in Damásco ,
traditions.KJV: Then David put [ garrisons ] in Syriadamascus ;

6.english_reference: and the Syrians became David ’s servants

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְ דָוִ֔יד עֲבָדִ֖ים

traditions.VUL: ut Sýria quoque servíret sibi ,

traditions.LXX: φέροντας δῶρα ·
traditions.VUL: et offérret múnera .
traditions.KJV: brought gifts .

6.english_reference: Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ לְ דָוִ֔יד בְּ כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσωζεν Κύριος Δαυεὶδ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύετο .
traditions.VUL: Adiuvítque eum Dóminus in cunctis , ad quæ perréxerat .
traditions.KJV: Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went .

7.english_reference: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗יד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַ זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ עַ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυεὶδ τοὺς κλοιοὺς τοὺς χρυσοῦς οἳ ἦσαν ἐπὶ τοὺς παῖδας Ἁδραάζαρ ,

traditions.KJV: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבִיאֵ֖ ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤνεγκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ .
traditions.VUL: et áttulit eas in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: and brought them to Jerusalem .

8.english_reference: Likewise from Tibhath , and from Chun , cities of Hadarezer , brought David very much brass

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ טִּבְחַ֤ת וּ מִ כּוּן֙ עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֔זֶר לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד

traditions.VUL: Necnon de Thebath , et Chun úrbibus Adarézer æris plúrimum ,

8.english_reference: wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass

traditions.WLC: בָּ֣ הּ עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת יָ֤ם הַ נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ וְ אֶת הָֽ עַמּוּדִ֔ים וְ אֵ֖ת כְּלֵ֥י הַ נְּחֹֽשֶׁת

traditions.VUL: de quo fecit Sálomon mare ǽneum , et colúmnas , et vasa ǽnea .
traditions.KJV: wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν Θῶα βασιλεὺς Ἡμὰθ ὅτι ἐπάταξεν Δαυεὶδ τὴν πᾶσαν δύναμιν Ἁδραάζαρ βασιλέως Σουβά ,

traditions.KJV: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah ;

10.english_reference: because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him

traditions.KJV: because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him ; (

10.english_reference: for Hadarezer had war with Tou

traditions.WLC: כִּי אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עוּ הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר

traditions.VUL: adversárius quippe erat Thou Adarézer .
traditions.KJV: for Hadarezer had war with Tou ; )

10.english_reference: and [ with him ] all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י זָהָ֥ב וָ כֶ֖סֶף וּ נְחֹֽשֶׁת
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντα σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ καὶ χρυσᾶ .
traditions.KJV: and [ with him ] all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .

11.english_reference: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD

traditions.WLC: גַּם אֹתָ֗ ם הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ הַ מֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לַ יהוָ֔ה

traditions.KJV: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD ,

traditions.KJV: with the silver and the gold that he brought from all [ these ] nations ;

11.english_reference: from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek

traditions.WLC: מֵֽ אֱד֤וֹם וּ מִ מּוֹאָב֙ וּ מִ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ מִ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּ מֵֽ עֲמָלֵֽק

traditions.KJV: from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek .

traditions.KJV: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand .

13.english_reference: And he put garrisons in Edom

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֤שֶׂם בֶּֽ אֱדוֹם֙ נְצִיבִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθετο ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι φρουράς ·
traditions.VUL: et constítuit in Edom præsídium ,
traditions.KJV: And he put garrisons in Edom ;

13.english_reference: and all the Edomites became David ’s servants

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּהְי֥וּ כָל אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְ דָוִ֑יד

traditions.VUL: ut servíret Idumǽa David :
traditions.KJV: and all the Edomites became David ’s servants .

traditions.KJV: Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went .

traditions.KJV: and executed judgment and justice among all his people .

15.english_reference: And Joab the son of Zeruiah [ was ] over the host

traditions.WLC: וְ יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל הַ צָּבָ֑א
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰωὰβ υἱὸς Σαρουιὰ ἐπὶ τῆς στρατείας ,
traditions.VUL: Porro Ioab fílius Sárviæ erat super exércitum ,
traditions.KJV: And Joab the son of Zeruiah [ was ] over the host ;

15.english_reference: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , recorder

traditions.WLC: וִ יהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰωσαφὰτ υἱὸς Ἀχειὰ ὑπομνηματογράφος ,
traditions.VUL: et Iósaphat fílius Ahilud a commentáriis .
traditions.KJV: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , recorder .

16.english_reference: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Abimelech the son of Abiathar , [ were ] the priests

traditions.WLC: וְ צָד֧וֹק בֶּן אֲחִיט֛וּב וַ אֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים
